{{Location infobox |name = Starpod |appearance = *[[Dorothy's Vision]] (mentioned) *[[Lone Trail]] *[[Retracing Our Steps]] |cnname = ”星荚” |jpname = 「星のさや」 |krname = '별깍지' |type = Planetary barrier |location = 6,152.31m ~ 6,972m {{Tip|AGL|above ground level}} from [[Terra]]}} The '''fake sky''', or poetically called the '''"Starpod"''',[[CW-2/Story#Before operation|CW-2 Before]] is a "wall" (more appropriately "barrier") that surrounds [[Terra|the world of]] ''[[Arknights]]''. It is the main subject of [[Lone Trail]] after being previously alluded to at the end of [[Dorothy's Vision]]. ==Overview== {{Dropbox|width=65%|Excerpt from the foreword to ''"Annals of the Royal Academy of Sciences: Astrology"'', 1059 Editionp. 356, "Rhine Lab LLC.: An Addendum", ''[[Terra: A Journey]]''.| The debate over the sky has been around ever since we first lay down on the grass and looked up at the starry heavens. For centuries, generation after generation of scholars devoted their entire lives to deciphering its ancient mysteries, only to see their efforts thwarted by its silent, cryptic veil.
[[Terra|This vast and entrancing land]] has left us with great swathes of wilderness where there is no knowledge. But in this wilderness, we have sowed the seeds of thought, watering it with research in which we saw potential. We believe what we are doing is meaningful. When the spring winds come, the sprouts of wisdom will break their shackles, turning the walls that once stood in our way to bastions of hope. Our descendants will stand upon all that we have built, and learn the truth behind the stars.}} [[File:Starry Skies.png|thumb|left|The seemingly ordinary skies of Terra is a "wall" that works both ways; while it keeps the Terrans from reaching out to space, it also keeps the planet safe from threats beyond]] Existing at the altitude between 6,152.31 m to 6,972 m above ground level, placing it around Terra's [[wikipedia:Troposphere|troposphere]], the Starpod is made up of dispersed high-energy particles creating an invisible barrier that tears apart any object attempting to pass through it by destabilizing their integrity and causing [[Arts]] devices to fail.[[Exclusive Release]] Contrary to popular belief, the Starpod is not a fully equally distributed barrier; it has no coherence, and projection of the barrier differs from regions to regions, meaning its thickness can be distinctively varied.[[Iana]]'s PUM-X [[Operator Module]] description It is impossible for the current Terran technology to penetrate the Starpod. Doing so would require an ''astronomical'' amount of energy — equal to that provided by the ''entire'' Terra and outside of [[Originium]]'s limits.[[CW-8/Story#Before operation|CW-8 Before]] Even if the Starpod is ever broken, the damage is temporary and the barrier will regenerate within as long a few years to as short as within days.[[CW-10/Story#After operation|CW-10 After]] The presence of the Starpod has a major ramification on Terra's technological development. In terms of aerodynamics, it prevents the Terrans from achieving high-altitude and orbital flight as well as spaceflight. Consequently, it keeps their aircrafts from operating beyond low and medium altitudes, and Terrans have to rely on [[wikipedia:VTOL|VTOLs]], drones, and helicopters for aerial transportion.p. 169, "Concept Art: Rhodes Island", ''[[Arknights Official Artworks]] Vol. 2'' Astronomy and space science suffer the greatest from underdevelopment of all fields of science as a consequence of the Starpod's presence. The barrier's high-energy particles and variable thickness cause [[wikipedia:Gravitational lensing|gravitational lensing]] that deflects starlight, making it difficult for the Terrans to accurately observe celestial bodies due to their displaced orbits relative to their [[wikipedia:Apparent place|apparent places]].[[Astesia/File|Astesia's Archive files]][[CW-ST-4]] Consequently, the "'''star drift'''" occurs in the Terran night sky: a phenomenon coined by astrologers describing the irregular, unpredictable, intractable, and drastic [[wikipedia:Retrograde and prograde motion|retrograde and prograde motions]] of celestial bodies, save for the [[Twin Moons]] due to their proximity to the planet. In a particular rare occurrence known as the "'''drift-freeze'''", the stars will even stay still at their apparent places for a very short time period, usually no more than a week, and with no forewarning. The distorted motion of the stars caused by the Starpod has also aroused heated debates among scientists and astrologers over the true nature of a night sky: whether the stars are really "disordered" or whether all the celestial bodies do have fixed orbits whose disorder is moreso caused by other, unknown factors.pg. 358-359, "Rhine Lab LLC.: An Addendum", ''[[Terra: A Journey]]''. ==Scientific research== {{Image list|Terra Atmospheric Profile.png|An atmospheric profile of Terra indicating its maximum height at the troposphere due to the Starpod. Do note the altitude measurement is based on above ground level (AGL).}} ===Discovery=== The proposal of the Starpod theory has been around since the 11th century thanks to technological advancement and inventions of simple aircrafts, but its discovery is as recent as a few decades. In the year 1075, the Wright couples, the parents of [[Rhine Lab]] director [[Kristen Wright]], conducted a test flight in attempt to pinpoint the Starpod's boundary by flying upon a high-altitude aircraft, aiming to reach beyond the barrier, but it predictably results in their demise.Chapter 6, ''[[Rhodes Island's Records of Originium - Rhine Lab]]''[[Rhine Lab Research Report]] Nevertheless, their sacrifice were monumental to scientists which demarcates the boundary of Terra's sky. After the discovery of the Starpod's border, further attempts have been made to exceed the limit, but all of them have ended in utter faliure due to the Starpod's unstable condition. The last attempt was a [[Leithanian]] Arts Detector Orb that crashed after flying up to around 500m below the level of the Starpod, and since then, the Terrans completely abandoned their interest to fly beyond the Starpod. ===Hypotheses=== Since the proposal of the Starpod theory and its discovery, scientists have disagreements over its origin and functions. There are several well-known proposed hypotheses regarding the Starpod in the science community: *'''"Originium insulator hypothesis"''': As the most prevailing theory, it suggests that the Starpod is formed by [[Catastrophe]] clouds lying at 6,000m above ground level based on measurements made by [[Catastrophe Messenger]]s and Originium environmentalists using multi-array laser rangefinders. While this is backed by several evidences, Originium particles can be found past the Starpod, hence Originium is not the major cause.p. 358, "Rhine Lab LLC.: An Addenum", ''[[Terra: A Journey]]''. *'''"Organic isolator theory"''': Proposed by [[Kazimierz]]ian scientists, it hypothesizes that the Starpod itself is literally organic and alive, although it was confirmed that the Starpod is inorganic. *'''"Paradox of adaptivity breakdown"''': First proposed by Professor [[Sinnach Weber]] of Wilhem-Herzog University, it hypothesizes that the Starpod could possibly be an endless void of Originium "ocean" lying beyond the planet. This is based on observations by some Leithanian scholars when they found out that Originium equipment shuts down and malfunctions on certain high-elevated regions that are close to the Starpod such as Mount Karlan. Hence, this not only suggests that the "disordered" stars are just mere explotions inside the void, but also it could best explain the origin of Originium as extraterrestrial substance. Nevertheless, academicians strongly refute it due to the uneven spread of Originium on the planet and the presence of the three [[Originium Prime Vein]]s.[[Correspondences From Laterano I]] *'''"Parthian Maximus"''': Another proposed theory regarding the Starpod mentioned briefly. ===Historical accounts=== Various legends and records exist depicting humans' attempt to conquer the sky and fly beyond the Starpod, but they are too exaggerated and bizarre to be quickly accepted as historical facts. One of these accounts is the [[Yan]]ese legend of [[Dusk Beauty|Hsi-o/''Xi'e'' the "Dusk Beauty"]], a woman who relied on ancient [[Originium Arts]] to lift herself to the Twin Moons and touch the sky in order to search for her missing husband. Many historians believe that this legend is the first recorded instance regarding human' contact with the Starpod. ==Post-Trimount Arc research== {{Main|Horizon Arc Project}} {{Image list |image1 =Sky-Splitting Pillar.png |caption1 = A hyperbeam is launched right into the Starpod... |image2 = The True Sky.png |caption2 = ...creating a gap which exposes one of Terra's Twin Moons for every Terran to see}} In 1096, R.L.'s expedition team led by [[Nasti Lunorey]] discovered the Hall of Stasis, a complex of [[Sarcophagus|Sarcophagi]] below [[Trimounts]] tended by [[Friston-3|Friston the Preserver]]. After seeking his knowledge regarding the Starpod for two years, Kristen managed to plot out a plan to penetrate it: the Hall's Sarcophagi would power up the {{Tip|S.H.A.F.T.|Synergistic Hyperbeam Amplifying and Focusing Tube}} and relay it into the {{Tip|H.A.M.H.R.R.|High-altitude Arrayed and Maneuverable Hyperbeam Receiver-Redirector}} on the ''[[Galleria Stellaria]]'' as part of [[Rhine Lab]]'s "[[Horizon Arc Project]]," and the ''Galleria'' would then fire off a hyperbeam at the Starpod which theoretically should be enough to pierce the Starpod. Upon the execution of the plan despite some interference, the hyperbeam fired by the H.A.M.H.R.R. momentarily created a disruption on the Starpod's thinest layer, resulting in aurora-like phenomenon visible across Terra, before creating a large gap or "hole" in the sky, a phenomenon later known as the 1099 "Trimount Arc" in history. Even though the outcome of the "Trimount Arc" resulted in the depowered ''Galleria Stellaria'' forever drifting in outer space, the gap in the Starpod created by Kristen allows the Terrans to finally study the actual night sky for the first time in history, ushering a new era in the Terran astronomy. Not only it unveiled the true appearance of the Twin Moons, but also scientists could now observe the stars in ease without fuzzing over their disordered orbits. [[File:Space Laboratory of Mt. Karlan.png|thumb|The proposed Rhine Lab space laboratory on Mt. Karlan built for the study of the Starpod]] The only known location that is nearest to the Starpod is [[Mount Karlan]] of [[Kjerag]], which is also Terra's tallest mountain, and as such there have been proposals to build an observation center on its peak. Its Originium-free zones and a lack of Catastrophe record for the past two centuries suggest that it is an ideal spot to conduct research regarding the sky without the aid of flying devices.[[Public Hearing]] On the other hand, scientists have to first negotiate with the local priests who strongly oppose bringing up science equipment onto their sacred mountain. In the aftermath of [[The Rides to Lake Silberneherze/Synopsis|Lake Silberneherze incident]], R.L succeeded in negotiating with [[Karlan Trade]] and became the first science institution to build a research station there, aiming to replicate the Trimounts launch near the mountain summit.[[Special Dispatch Kjerag]] In the meantime, R.L. continues to lobby for governmental support of the project while at the same time keeping with their latest updates. The Kjerag Observation Station was finally completed in October 1101, marking a new chapter in Kjerag and Columbia's scientific endeavours.[[OS-1/Story#After operation|OS-1 After]] On December 7th, 1101, an unidentified orb-like object fell through the hole in the Starpod and crash landed on [[Mount Karlan]], marking the first time an extraterrestrial object has ever fallen onto Terra.[[OS-6/Story#After operation|OS-6 After]] ==Origin== The Starpod is in reality one of the creations of the alien, space-faring "[[Predecessor]]s" who once colonized the Terran planet but now went extinct after a certain "disaster from above". It has its origin from the ''outside'' of the Terran planet, making it more as an extraterrestrial containment purposely surrounding the planet. In fact, before the formation of the Starpod, Terrans could actually observe stars easily. Many legends describe ancient Terrans following the path of the stars to search for potential settlements. Hence, the Starpod's formation could be as recent as the dawn of the Terran civilization.[[DISCOVERED TERRA 3.0]]{{Col|Ancient Fresco}} description The Starpod could have unknown twofold purposes. It is possible that it could keep Terra safe from the hands of the [[Observer]]s. Alternatively, the Starpod could be meant to contain Originium in the planet, as in a possible alternative timeline, it managed to break through the Starpod and assimilates other planets and lifeforms beyond Terra.{{O|Remnant}} Talk at Elite 1 dialogue Because of the Starpod's role, [[Kal'tsit]] expresses strong concern [[Kristen Wright]]'s "Horizon Arc Project" knowing that it would bring a potential apocalypse to the planet, and the aftermath of the incident makes her uncertained regarding the Terrans' unprepared future. ==References== {{Reflist}} {{Worldview}} [[Category:Lore]]
